sentences.en: The mother extended her hand to her baby, smiling brightly.
sentences.zh: 妈妈微笑着伸出手抱起她的婴儿。

sentences.en: The old woman extended a loving hand to the children.
sentences.zh: 老妇人慈爱地伸出手抚摸着孩子们。

sentences.en: Better to extend an olive branch than launch a missile.
sentences.zh: 与其发射导弹，不如伸出橄榄枝为好。

senses.zh: 延长；扩展；达到(某一点) - 尽可能地伸开(身体某部) - 给予，提供，发出

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ex（出）+tend（伸展）→伸展出去→延长
